name: SL2S J022357-065142 (Hubble)
blurb: SL2S J022357-065142, a candidate gravitational lens, seen by Hubble.
label: sl2sj022357065142-hubble
story: A galaxy that may act as a gravitational lens, bending the light of a more distant source behind it. Hubble looked here to study how massive early-type galaxies form and evolve.

claims.text: SL2S J022357-065142 is a high-priority gravitational lens candidate in Hubble program 11588
The program uses gravitational lensing to study the origin and evolution of early-type galaxies
It is part of the Strong Lensing Legacy Survey (SL2S) sample
